text: In a three-neck round-bottom flask, 25 mL of ODE and 325 mg of DDAB (0.8 mmol) were added. The mixture was magnetically stirred at 700 rpm and degassed at 120 °C under an argon atmosphere for 30 minutes. After degassing, the temperature was increased to 180 °C, and 1.4 mL (10.36 mmol) of Fe(CO)5, was injected through the septa to maintain an inert atmosphere and prevent air exposure of the precursor.

source.title: Phase transfer studies of iron oxide nanoparticles: characterization based insights for applications
